---
name: Bug or workflow failure
about: Report a reproducible problem without private data
---

## What happened / expected behavior

## Version and environment
Pack version, OS/Python, host/version/model if relevant. No credentials.

## Minimal synthetic reproduction
Exact workflow, command, redacted input and steps.

## Actual evidence
Return code, sanitized logs, screenshots or report. Distinguish model behavior
from deterministic helper failure. Do not attach customer records or auth files.

## Scope and impact
What broke? Was anything sent, published or deployed?

Security vulnerabilities: use private reporting when enabled; see SECURITY.md.
